layers.authority: Agence de mise en valeur du patrimoine et de promotion culturelle (AMVPPC), under the Ministry of Cultural Affairs
layers.process: El Jem amphitheatre and museum: category B, foreign non-resident visitors 20 dinars from 1 April 2026, rising to 30 dinars in January 2027. Reduced rate of 2 dinars for pupils, students and holders of the Jeune card. Free days include the first Sunday of each month, public holidays, 18 April and 18 May.

sources.title: Musées et sites archéologiques : nouvelle grille tarifaire dès le 1er avril

zone-requirements.note: Signal only: the price schedule comes from a Tunisian news report of a joint order of the Finance and Cultural Affairs ministries, in force from 1 April 2026; the order itself and the Agence de mise en valeur du patrimoine (AMVPPC) price list were not reached. Another report places Carthage and El Jem in category A from a later date, so confirm the category. No RBA or central-bank rate for TND is held in this repo, so no A$ figure is given. Dougga's category and price were not found.
